scope: Recorded source frames delivered on a wall-clock schedule to the production reading controller, local worker, comparison UI and item logger. Auto read, colour inference and item logging enabled; default seeded crafting fields. Game viewport is manually selected. Capture chooser/stream and interactive field calibration are bypassed. Nearest manually labelled timestamp within two seconds proposes encounter identity; exact names/values are checked independently. Unknown 250s artifact is not labelled. No precise first-readable boundaries: do not interpret read duration as end-to-end latency, or unmatched reads as proven stale/mixed artifacts. No held-out sessions or personalized collection/profile.
